description:
Yunxuan 9 is a name that appears for a Yunnan tea cultivar, and very little is documented about it. Its origin, its breeder and its traits are all unclear, so there is little to say with confidence.

Calling it a green tea is a working label and not an established fact. A cultivar can be made into more than one type of tea, and the region it is linked to is better known for large-leaf black and pu-erh.

If you come across a tea sold as Yunxuan 9, ask the seller where it was grown, who made it and how. Taste it for what it is, and do not assume anything about it from the name.
